name: Mad Labs Disposable | Lemon Cherry Gelato
description: A balanced hybrid known for its dessert-like sweetness and uplifting-yet-relaxing effects, offering a smooth mix of mood elevation and gentle body calm ideal for anytime unwinding. A burst of tangy lemon and ripe cherry sweetness layered with subtle berry undertones and a smooth, lightly earthy finish.
